segments.text: Let's show you the difference between
the same PCB visualization task done on
Altium Designer 25 versus using an
outside
tool. The task at hand is to measure the
distance between a hidden component and
its enclosure. So, let's get started. On
the right, the engineer is leaving
Alteium Designer to use a mechanical CAD
tool. And on the left, the engineer is
using the built-in PCB section view tool
available in Altium Designer 25.
Utilizing Alteium Designer's built-in
PCB section view tool took a mere 1
minute and 5 seconds and only required
13 mouse clicks, while the process
without using Altium Designer took 7
minutes and 45 seconds, requiring 26
mouse clicks, showing a clear advantage
in using Altium Designer 25's unified
design environment for your PCB
visualization needs.

title: Unveiling 86% Task Time Efficiency in Altium Designer 25
